name: Massachusetts Bay Technologies
old_description: Founded in 1999, Massachusetts Bay Technologies (MBT) is a company specializing in the engineering, manufacture, & distribution of discrete silicon RF/Microwave semiconductor devices, single layer ceramic capacitors and thin film products. MBT is committed to the continuance of innovations in service to its customers, improvement of design, product performance, and quality control.
about:
Massachusetts Bay Technologies (MBT) was founded in 1999 in Stoughton, Massachusetts. The company began as a specialist in the engineering, manufacture, and distribution of discrete silicon RF and microwave semiconductor devices, single-layer ceramic capacitors, and thin-film products.

MBT produces a range of RF and microwave components, including silicon diodes, ceramic capacitors, and thin-film devices operating from 100 Hz to millimeter-wave frequencies. The company operates its own manufacturing and screening facilities, offering high-reliability testing up to space-level qualifications per MIL‑STD‑19500 and MIL‑STD‑750, with three screening tiers (TX, TXV, and S). Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2008 and includes incoming material inspection, equipment calibration, and a controlled ESD program.

The company serves academic and laboratory research, consumer electronics, telecommunications, military, and space programs. It positions itself as a primary source for hard‑to‑find or obsolete RF and microwave diodes, capacitors, and thin-film parts.

MBT states that its founding purpose was to continue innovation in service to customers, improving design, product performance, and quality control across its product lines.

old_description: Master Sheet Metal, Inc. has been servicing Hawaii since 1970 as a sheet metal and mechanical subcontractor on government, commercial, and residential projects throughout the State of Hawaii. about:
Master Sheet Metal, Inc. has been operating in Honolulu, Hawaii since 1970 as a sheet metal and mechanical subcontractor. The company is locally owned and operated by lifelong residents of the islands.

The firm runs a fully equipped production shop where skilled craftsmen fabricate and install a range of sheet metal products, including air conditioning and ventilation systems, metal roofing and siding, gutters and downspouts, architectural sheet metal flashings and custom fabrications, and trash chute systems. Materials worked include aluminum, galvanized steel, stainless steel, copper, and zincalume.

Master Sheet Metal serves government, commercial, and residential projects across the State of Hawaii. Its project portfolio spans commercial and retail buildings, condominium and high-rise towers, educational facilities, healthcare centers, hotels and resorts, military installations, residential developments, and restaurant and food service establishments.

The company states its mission is to deliver quality customer service and results with integrity and dedication. It emphasizes building solid client relationships, partnering with all project stakeholders, and maintaining flexibility and responsiveness to customer needs as keys to project success.

name: Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber Inc
old_description: Welcome to Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber – your go-to source for hardwood, plywood, and custom moldings. Our family’s been serving the local community since 1983, providing premium lumber products for all kinds of projects, and doing whatever it takes to guarantee your complete satisfaction.
about:
Mastercraft Hardwood Lumber Inc has operated from Sparks, Nevada since 1983 as a family-owned lumber supplier. The company was established to serve the local community with hardwood, plywood, and custom millwork, and remains locally owned after four decades.

The business stocks a wide range of North American and exotic hardwoods—from alder to walnut—along with cabinet-grade and construction-grade plywood. Its workshop produces custom moldings, trim, and millwork to exact specifications, and it maintains a rotating inventory of live-edge slabs and epoxy systems for resin table projects. A showroom and lumber yard allow customers to inspect materials in person.

Mastercraft serves contractors, woodworkers, furniture makers, interior designers, and industrial paneling buyers. Its products are used in structural applications, cabinetry, fine furniture, and both interior and exterior design projects. The company also supplies branded lines such as Saroyan Hardwoods and Orepac.

The company emphasizes its local ownership, competitive pricing, and a satisfaction guarantee backed by repeat customers. It was founded to provide a versatile wood selection and custom millwork capability under one roof, aiming to be a single source for both raw lumber and finished profiles.

name: Mather Process Solutions
old_description: We specialize in further processing equipment. We have a large variety of used equipment that can be purchased in as is condition, most of these items are also available as fully remanufactured items that come with a warranty.
about:
Mather Process Solutions operates from Bellevue, Ohio, where it was founded in 1951. The company runs its Process Equipment Warehouse division from this location, though details about its ownership structure or founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The business focuses on further processing equipment for the food industry, offering both used machinery sold as-is and fully remanufactured units backed by a warranty. Its capabilities span sales, design, service, and remanufacturing of equipment such as breaders, batter applicators, fryers, ovens, conveyors, and oil filtration systems. The company emphasizes on-site testing and a 100% performance guarantee on remanufactured items.

Mather Process Solutions serves food manufacturers and further-processing operations, working with OEM brands including Stein, JBT, and MP Equipment. The company actively seeks specific models like the Stein DB-4 Drum Breeder and MP Equipment 120 Drum Breeder for its inventory, and recently featured a Stein JBT HPF 3423 gas-fired fryer as equipment of the month.

The company highlights its 75-plus years of experience in the sector and its commitment to on-site testing with a full performance guarantee as key differentiators. It also provides a warranty on remanufactured equipment, aiming to reduce risk for buyers of used processing machinery.

name: Matix Corporation
old_description: Matix Corporation of America is a world class metal machining manufacturer of O.E.M. automotive parts ranging from aluminum oil pan housings, 4-wheel driver adaptor housings, oil pump covers, and many more.  We are the largest value-added machining supplier to Asian Automotive in North America.
about:
Matix Corporation of America was founded in 2001 in Pioneer, Tennessee, nestled in the mountains of Campbell County. The company began as a cylinder head machining operation in a 40,000-square-foot facility, breaking ground that year as its phase 1 operation. Over the next two decades, Matix expanded its footprint and capabilities to become a dedicated producer of machined automotive components.

Today, the company operates a 106,000-square-foot plant housing 13 product lines that produce over two million machined components annually. Using automated CNC machining centers and modern robotics, Matix manufactures engine, drivetrain, and chassis parts such as aluminum oil pan housings, four-wheel-drive adaptor housings, oil pump covers, crankcase stiffeners, and fluid coupling cases. The facility employs over 110 team members.

Matix serves the automotive OEM market as a Tier 2 supplier, notably to Toyota, and describes itself as the largest value-added machining supplier to Asian automotive manufacturers in North America. Its customer base includes top global automakers requiring high-volume, precision-machined metal parts.

The company emphasizes precision quality processes and automation to meet the demands of top global automakers, leveraging its ISO 9001-certified quality system to ensure consistent part quality across high-volume production runs.

old_description: Matz Equipment was founded with one mission — to provide dependable service and repair for automotive and industrial equipment. Over the years, we’ve grown into a trusted partner for businesses and individuals, offering everything from routine maintenance to complex mechanical overhauls. about:
Matz Equipment was founded in 1992 in Bridgeport, West Virginia, as a family-owned business with a mission to provide dependable service and repair for automotive and industrial equipment. The company began as a one-call solution for shop equipment needs, focusing on honest, reliable workmanship.

The firm specializes in installation, inspection, maintenance, and repair of vehicle lifts (including scissor, two-post, four-post, in-ground, and motorcycle lifts), alignment systems, lube systems, and air compressors. It also supplies parts and accessories through relationships with top U.S. lift manufacturers, operating with a small team of dedicated technicians who handle most service calls within days.

Customers span commercial automotive dealers, motorcycle and ATV shops, tire and body shops, antique car collectors, oil and gas firms, environmental and industrial companies, as well as municipal, county, state, and military facilities across the Mid-Atlantic region.

The company emphasizes a customer-first approach, quick response times, and competitive pricing enabled by its regional location and supplier network. Its inspectors undergo rigorous training to certify lifts with an inspection certificate, aiming to reduce downtime and long-term maintenance costs for clients.

name: Maui Auto Parts
old_description: AC Delco, Motorcraft, Mopar, Bosch, Denso, NGK, Aisin, Advics, Lucas Oil Products, Castro Edge, Grote, Rhino Pac, Westar, Walker, Maval, AMS Automotive, Hayden Automotive, classic Volkswagon parts and accessories, and so much more.
about:
Maui Auto Parts operates from Wailuku, Hawaii, tracing its origins to 1989 when Aloha Otto Parts opened on Dairy Road in Kahului. In 2011 the business merged with Pacific Jobbers Warehouse on Oahu and adopted the Maui Auto Parts name. Today it is the only employee‑owned auto parts company in Maui and the state of Hawaii.

The company distributes original‑equipment and name‑brand auto parts across categories including ignition, fuel, electrical, braking, steering, drivetrain, engine, and fluid systems, plus a specialty line of classic Volkswagen components. Its Wailuku warehouse stocks roughly 86,000 line items on Maui, with an additional 500,000 parts available from its Oahu facility and access to millions more from mainland suppliers. Maui Auto Parts also runs a commercial e‑commerce platform that integrates with shop management systems such as Mitchell 1, offering VIN and plate‑to‑VIN lookups, order history, and inventory visibility.

Primary customers are professional repair shops, fleet operators, and independent technicians throughout Wailuku, Kahului, Kihei, Lahaina, and Up Country Maui. The business also serves retail walk‑in customers and classic Volkswagen enthusiasts. Free same‑day or next‑day delivery is provided to commercial accounts across its service area.

The employee‑ownership structure is cited as a key differentiator, aligning staff incentives with customer service. The company emphasizes knowledgeable counter specialists, a broad brand portfolio from AC Delco, Motorcraft, Bosch, Denso, and others, and a willingness to source hard‑to‑find parts from its extended network.

about:
Maxzone Auto Part Corp. was established in 1997 in Fontana, California, as the North American distribution arm of DEPO, a Taiwanese automotive lighting manufacturer founded in 1978 in Lukang, Taiwan. The company operates as an ISO‑certified distributor with four strategically placed warehouses across the United States.

The facilities support fast delivery throughout North America, backed by vehicle test‑fit protocols, scratch‑ and UV‑resistant lens coatings, and a one‑year limited warranty on select items.

The company serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting repair shops, distributors, and retailers across North America. Its product lines cover tail lamps, fog lamps, turn signals, side markers, headlamps, mirrors, and related components for passenger vehicles and heavy‑duty applications. Maxzone exhibits regularly at AAPEX, the automotive aftermarket expo, to reach industry buyers.

Maxzone’s stated mission is to satisfy customers with quality products, competitive value, and comprehensive service, guided by ethics, teamwork, and responsive customer service. Its vision is to lead the importing, warehousing, and distribution of aftermarket automotive products, leveraging DEPO’s decades of R&D and manufacturing expertise.

name: Maysteel Industries, LLC
old_description: Maysteel delivers scalable fabrication for data centers, critical infrastructure and diversified industrial markets. From custom enclosures and high-density server racks to aisle containment systems, we provide the capacity, operational discipline and execution reliability required for complex, high-volume programs.
about:
Maysteel Industries, LLC was founded in 1936 in Allenton, Wisconsin. The company began as a metal fabrication shop and has grown into a scalable fabricator for data centers, critical infrastructure, and diversified industrial markets.

The company produces custom enclosures, high-density server racks, aisle containment systems, and prefabricated modular structures for data centers, along with generator enclosures, PDU enclosures, padmount tanks, and transformer enclosures for critical infrastructure. Its vertically integrated model includes direct relationships with steel mills, strategic material inventory, and advanced manufacturing technology such as tube lasers, robotic welding, fiber laser welding, and expanded automation. In-house engineering supports design-for-manufacturing from concept through production.

Maysteel serves data center operators, utility companies, and renewable energy firms, providing OCP-recognized solutions for high-density computing environments, grid resilience equipment, and outdoor enclosures for solar inverters, energy storage, and generators.

The company emphasizes its nearly 90 years of fabrication expertise, engineering-first approach, and investments in automation to control supply, capacity, and lead times for complex, high-volume programs.

name: McDonald Plastic Molding, Inc.
old_description: You wouldn't trust just anyone to produce the components for fluid handling - but know that you can rely on the experts at McDonald Plastic Molding. Plastic is often chosen as the material of choice for this job due to its resistance to corrosion, scale buildup, and sweating. The process of molding and assembling the plastic components required for fluid handling includes engineered resins and tight tolerance molding. McDonald Plastic Molding utilizes precision machining and the most accurate tools possible so that your satisfaction is guaranteed!
about:
McDonald Plastic Molding, Inc. is headquartered in Monroe, Wisconsin, with additional manufacturing facilities in Cuba City and Darlington. The company was formed in January 2021 when A.Y. McDonald combined the operations of S.K. Plastic Molding, Inc. and Non-Metallic Components, Inc. into a single customer-focused organization.

The molder runs 69 injection molding machines ranging from 55 to 550 tons, processing engineering thermoplastics such as polypropylene, ABS, acetal, nylon, polycarbonate, polystyrene, PC/ABS, PPO, PSU, PEI, and PEEK. Beyond molding, the company provides engineering upfront development design, tooling design and resurrection, and a full suite of secondary operations including light assembly, pad printing, sonic and spin welding, hot stamping, laser etching, and kitting. Advanced quality systems feature statistical process control, leak testing, pressure decay testing, and automated inspection.

McDonald Plastic Molding serves a broad range of sectors: automotive, consumer, electrical, industrial, water filtration, military, recreational vehicle, medical, fluid handling, education, electronics, hardware, home products, marketing products, plumbing, and sporting goods. Customers rely on the firm for both prototype and production volumes, with the ability to manage complex assemblies and decorating in-house.

The company differentiates itself through a customer-first philosophy — internally described as "the customer is the boss" — and a willingness to tackle difficult projects that other molders decline, such as reviving old tooling. Its vertical integration of design, tooling, molding, assembly, and decorating under one roof is intended to reduce lead times and ensure accountability from concept to delivery.
